# dodopayments_product (Data Source)

Reads one product by its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dodopayments_addon" "example" {
  currency     = "USD"
  name         = "example-addon"
  price        = 100
  tax_category = "digital_products"
}

resource "dodopayments_credit_entitlement" "example" {
  currency         = "USD"
  name             = "example-credit-entitlement"
  overage_enabled  = false
  precision        = 2
  price_per_unit   = "10.5"
  rollover_enabled = false
  unit             = "credits"
}

resource "dodopayments_entitlement" "example" {
  integration_config = {
    feature_id   = "example-entitlement"
    feature_type = "boolean"
  }
  integration_type = "feature_flag"
  metadata = {
    tier = "pro"
  }
  name = "example-entitlement"
}

resource "dodopayments_product" "example" {
  addons = [dodopayments_addon.example.id]
  credit_entitlements = [{
    credit_entitlement_id = dodopayments_credit_entitlement.example.id
    credits_amount        = "100.0"
  }]
  entitlements = [{
    entitlement_id = dodopayments_entitlement.example.id
  }]
  metadata = {
    plan = "pro"
  }
  name = "example-product"
  price = {
    type                         = "recurring_price"
    currency                     = "USD"
    price                        = 1000
    payment_frequency_count      = 1
    payment_frequency_interval   = "Month"
    subscription_period_count    = 1
    subscription_period_interval = "Year"
  }
  pricing_mode = "by_currency"
  tax_category = "saas"
}

data "dodopayments_product" "example" {
  id = dodopayments_product.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the product.

### Read-Only

- `addons` (Set of String) Available Addons for subscription products.
- `brand_id` (String)
- `business_id` (String) Unique identifier for the business to which the product belongs.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the product was created.
- `credit_entitlements` (Attributes List) Attached credit entitlements with settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credit_entitlements))
- `description` (String) Description of the product, optional.
- `entitlements` (Attributes List) Attached entitlements (integration-based access grants). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entitlements))
- `is_recurring` (Boolean) Indicates if the product is recurring (e.g., subscriptions).
- `metadata` (Map of String) Additional custom data associated with the product.
- `name` (String) Name of the product, optional.
- `price` (Attributes) Pricing information for the product. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--price))
- `pricing_mode` (String) Pricing mode for localized pricing. NULL means base-only (no localized rules apply).
- `product_collection_id` (String) The product collection ID this product belongs to, if any.
- `product_id` (String) Unique identifier for the product.
- `tax_category` (String) Tax category associated with the product.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the product was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--credit_entitlements"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credit_entitlements`

Read-Only:

- `credit_entitlement_id` (String) ID of the credit entitlement.
- `credit_entitlement_name` (String) Name of the credit entitlement.
- `credit_entitlement_unit` (String) Unit label for the credit entitlement.
- `credits_amount` (String) Number of credits granted.
- `currency` (String) Currency.
- `expires_after_days` (Number) Days until credits expire.
- `id` (String) Unique ID of this mapping.
- `low_balance_threshold_percent` (Number) Low balance threshold percentage.
- `max_rollover_count` (Number) Maximum rollover cycles.
- `overage_behavior` (String) Controls how overage is handled at billing cycle end.
- `overage_enabled` (Boolean) Whether overage is enabled.
- `overage_limit` (String) Overage limit.
- `price_per_unit` (String) Price per unit.
- `proration_behavior` (String) Proration behavior for credit grants during plan changes.
- `rollover_enabled` (Boolean) Whether rollover is enabled.
- `rollover_percentage` (Number) Rollover percentage.
- `rollover_timeframe_count` (Number) Rollover timeframe count.
- `rollover_timeframe_interval` (String) Rollover timeframe interval.
- `trial_credits` (String) Trial credits.
- `trial_credits_expire_after_trial` (Boolean) Whether trial credits expire after trial.


<a id="nestedatt--entitlements"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entitlements`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `integration_config` (Attributes) Integration-specific configuration on an entitlement read response.

For `digital_files` entitlements the response includes presigned
download URLs for each attached file; other integrations match the
shape supplied at creation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entitlements--integration_config))
- `integration_type` (String)
- `name` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--entitlements--integration_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entitlements.integration_config`

Read-Only:

- `activation_message` (String) Optional message displayed when a customer activates the license
key (≤ 2500 characters).
- `activations_limit` (Number) Maximum activations allowed per issued license key. Omit for unlimited.
- `chat_id` (String) Telegram chat ID. For groups this is typically a negative integer.
- `digital_files` (Attributes) Populated digital-files payload with each file's metadata and a
short-lived presigned download URL. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entitlements--integration_config--digital_files))
- `duration_count` (Number) Validity duration of issued license keys. Provide both
`duration_count` and `duration_interval` together for a fixed
duration; omit both for non-expiring keys.
- `duration_interval` (String) Unit of `duration_count`.
- `feature_id` (String) Merchant-chosen identifier for the capability this entitlement unlocks.
- `feature_type` (String) Type of capability conferred. Only `boolean` is supported today.
- `figma_file_id` (String) Figma file identifier to grant access to.
- `framer_template_id` (String) Framer template identifier to grant access to.
- `fulfillment_mode` (String) How license keys are fulfilled. `auto` (default) generates and delivers
keys to customers automatically; `manual` creates pending grants that you
fulfill with the supplied key via `POST /grants/{grant_id}/license-key`.
- `guild_id` (String) Discord guild (server) ID.
- `notion_template_id` (String) Notion template identifier to grant access to.
- `permission` (String) Permission to grant on the repository.
- `role_id` (String) Optional Discord role to assign within the guild.
- `target_id` (String) Repository or organisation slug to grant access to.

<a id="nestedatt--entitlements--integration_config--digital_files"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entitlements.integration_config.digital_files`

Read-Only:

- `external_url` (String) Optional external URL, passed through from the entitlement
configuration. A JSON document. Use `jsonencode()` to set it.
- `files` (String) One entry per attached file. A JSON document. Use `jsonencode()` to set it.
- `instructions` (String) Optional human-readable delivery instructions, passed through from
the entitlement configuration. A JSON document. Use `jsonencode()` to set it.




<a id="nestedatt--price"></a>
### Nested Schema for `price`

Read-Only:

- `currency` (String) The currency in which the payment is made.
- `discount` (Number) Deprecated: use `discount_bps` instead.

Discount applied to the price, represented as a percentage (0 to 100).
A response rounds this value to the nearest whole percent.
Defaults to `0`.
- `discount_bps` (Number) Discount applied to the price, in basis points. 100 basis points make
one percent, so `1250` is a discount of 12.5%.

Use this field for a discount with a fraction of a percent. A request
that sends this field ignores `discount`. A value of `0` gives no
discount.
- `fixed_price` (Number) The fixed payment amount. Represented in the lowest denomination of the currency (e.g., cents for USD).
For example, to charge $1.00, pass `100`. Only for `type` `usage_based_price`. Required when `type` is `usage_based_price`.
- `meters` (Attributes List) Only for `type` `usage_based_price`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--price--meters))
- `pay_what_you_want` (Boolean) Indicates whether the customer can pay any amount they choose.
If set to `true`, the [`price`](Self::price) field is the minimum amount. Only for `type` `one_time_price`.
- `payment_frequency_count` (Number) Number of `payment_frequency_interval` units between two charges.
This field sets the billing cycle.
For example, `1` with a `payment_frequency_interval` of `month` charges the customer every month. Only for `type` `recurring_price` or `usage_based_price`. Required when `type` is `recurring_price` or `usage_based_price`.
- `payment_frequency_interval` (String) The time unit of the billing cycle (e.g., day, month, year).
Use it with `payment_frequency_count`. Only for `type` `recurring_price` or `usage_based_price`. Required when `type` is `recurring_price` or `usage_based_price`.
- `price` (Number) The payment amount, in the smallest denomination of the currency (e.g., cents for USD).
For example, to charge $1.00, pass `100`.

If [`pay_what_you_want`](Self::pay_what_you_want) is set to `true`, this field represents
the **minimum** amount the customer must pay. Only for `type` `one_time_price` or `recurring_price`. Required when `type` is `one_time_price` or `recurring_price`.
- `purchasing_power_parity` (Boolean) Opts this price in to purchasing power parity. The business must also
enable purchasing power parity. The discount percentage per country is
always business-wide. Defaults to `false`.
- `subscription_period_count` (Number) Number of `subscription_period_interval` units for the total duration of the subscription.
This field does not set the billing cycle. Use `payment_frequency_count` for the billing cycle.
When this period ends, the subscription expires. Dodo Payments does not start a new
billing cycle after the subscription expires. Dodo Payments can still retry a failed
payment for an earlier billing cycle.

For a subscription that renews until the customer cancels it, set this to `20` with a
`subscription_period_interval` of `year`. This is the recommended value and also the maximum.
The subscription expires after 20 years if the customer does not cancel it before then.

For example, a monthly plan uses a `payment_frequency_count` of `1`, a `payment_frequency_interval`
of `month`, and a subscription period of `20` `year`. Do not set the subscription period to
`1` `month` for a monthly plan: the subscription then expires after one month. Only for `type` `recurring_price` or `usage_based_price`. Required when `type` is `recurring_price` or `usage_based_price`.
- `subscription_period_interval` (String) The time unit of the total subscription duration (e.g., day, month, year).
Use it with `subscription_period_count`. The recommended value is `year`, with a
`subscription_period_count` of `20`. Only for `type` `recurring_price` or `usage_based_price`. Required when `type` is `recurring_price` or `usage_based_price`.
- `suggested_price` (Number) A suggested price for the user to pay. This value is only considered if
[`pay_what_you_want`](Self::pay_what_you_want) is `true`. Otherwise, it is ignored. Only for `type` `one_time_price`.
- `tax_inclusive` (Boolean) Indicates if the price is tax inclusive.
- `trial_amount` (Number) Amount charged today for a paid trial, in the price currency's minor units.
Requires `trial_period_days > 0`. Omit or null for a free trial (the default). Only for `type` `recurring_price`.
- `trial_apply_discounts` (Boolean) Whether discount codes reduce the trial charge. Defaults to false. Only meaningful
when a paid trial is configured. Only for `type` `recurring_price`.
- `trial_payment_method_optional` (Boolean) Let a customer start a free trial with no card. Defaults to false. Only for `type` `recurring_price`.
- `trial_period_days` (Number) Number of days for the trial period. A value of `0` indicates no trial period. Only for `type` `recurring_price`.
- `type` (String)
- `zero_amount_payment_method_optional` (Boolean) Let a customer start a subscription with no card, when the amount due
today is `0` (a native `0` price, or a 100% discount). Defaults to false. Only for `type` `recurring_price`.

<a id="nestedatt--price--meters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `price.meters`

Read-Only:

- `credit_entitlement_id` (String) Optional credit entitlement ID to link this meter to for credit-based billing.
- `description` (String) Meter description. Will ignored on Request, but will be shown in response.
- `free_threshold` (Number)
- `measurement_unit` (String) Meter measurement unit. Will ignored on Request, but will be shown in response.
- `meter_id` (String)
- `meter_units_per_credit` (String) Number of meter units that equal one credit. Required when credit_entitlement_id is set.
- `name` (String) Meter name. Will ignored on Request, but will be shown in response.
- `price_per_unit` (String) The price per unit in lowest denomination. Must be greater than zero. Supports up to 5 digits before decimal point and 12 decimal places.
